name: Premium Profile Card Addon for Elementor
author: Md Hazrath Ali

sections.description:
Premium Profile Card is a powerful Elementor addon that allows you to display user profile information in stunning card layouts. With this plugin, you can create stylish profile cards for users, members, or team profiles with complete design flexibility.

Unlike simple shortcode plugins, Premium Profile Card integrates directly with Elementor, giving you drag-and-drop control over layout, typography, colors, and more.

Key Features:

  • Full Elementor widget support – drag-and-drop anywhere on your pages
  • Display logged-in user profiles or custom users
  • Multiple predefined card styles with advanced customization
  • Responsive design with mobile and tablet controls
  • PSR-4 autoloaded, clean, and extendable codebase
  • Developer-friendly for template overrides and extensions
  • Fully compatible with WordPress coding standards and modern PHP

Premium Profile Card gives you total control over every part of your profile cards:
– Background, border, and shadow styling
– Custom avatar display with optional fallback
– User meta, role, and custom fields
– Buttons and social links
– Typography and color options

Perfect for membership sites, directories, team pages, or any site requiring professional profile displays.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/premium-profile-card-addon-for-elementor or install via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Open Elementor and search for Premium Profile Card in the widgets panel.
  4. Drag the widget onto any page or template and customize styles using Elementor controls.
  5. Optionally, run composer install if you want to enable autoloaded helper classes (for developers extending the plugin).
sections.faq:
Can I show a profile card for users other than the logged-in user?

Yes! You can select specific users in the Elementor widget settings. Future updates may include dynamic user selection based on post author or custom queries.

Is the plugin fully customizable?

Absolutely! All styles and layouts are editable in Elementor. Developers can also override templates or extend functionality via the autoloaded PHP classes.

Does this plugin support responsive layouts?

Yes, all cards are fully responsive and include controls for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
